name: ETS transcription factor ERG
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ERG encodes transcriptional regulator ERG. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
